canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Mutual Of Omaha Mortgage denied {value} of its 8,133 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Mutual Of Omaha Mortgage decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Mutual Of Omaha Mortgage will deny any specific future application with 42.1% probability
Mutual Of Omaha Mortgage is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Mutual Of Omaha Mortgage discriminates or violates law
42.1% applies to Mutual Of Omaha Mortgage's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
